package.name: nidar_safety
package.description: Flight envelope guard: the last line of defence between the planner (/planning/pos_cmd) and MAVROS. Validates every setpoint against the arena volume and holds position on rejection. Safety-critical, so it is kept in its own package with no dependency on perception, mapping or the mission FSM. Limits are loaded from nidar_config/config/flight_envelope_guard.yaml.
